## **Why Venture Guides**

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/62e401790584200f7f586fe2/85d98391-5487-4784-82f2-00d57b5fd9be/blue-dash.png)

With decades of experience building and investing in successful software companies, Venture Guides accelerates its portfolio companies with proven, team-based expertise; 10+% personal investment in its funds; and a mission to bring the most impactful new enterprise software to the market.

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/62e401790584200f7f586fe2/f0e399ad-1778-4dd6-a250-097abd221edf/team-based-investing-icon.png)

#### **Team-based Investing**

We take a unique approach to investing our funds, using proven, data-driven frameworks and leveraging deep operational experience to collaborate, consult, and invest as a team.

[Meet our team](https://www.ventureguides.com/our-team)

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/62e401790584200f7f586fe2/61f3f96e-7162-418e-a74b-20f9c860a6da/active-guidance-icon.png)

#### **Team-based Guiding**

Venture Guides supports founders through every step of their early journey to building a great company. Each partner and investor is committed to advising and guiding, across business strategy, finance, budgeting, and go to market execution.

[See what makes us different](https://www.ventureguides.com/philosophy)

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/62e401790584200f7f586fe2/afb7391e-3512-4720-ac7c-d3be752eea06/cloud-gear-icon.png)

#### **Deep Domain Expertise**

Our laser-focused sector experience ensures we are positioned to understand each start-up's strategic market opportunity and its micro-trends. Venture Guides' domain-specific investments allow us to provide our teams with informed context and relevant guidance, while actively avoiding a "spray and pray" approach.

[View our Guided Companies](https://www.ventureguides.com/guided-companies)

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/62e401790584200f7f586fe2/6c12339b-af81-4fab-87e1-7ad2815148ec/success-bg.jpg)
